stem.en: What distinguishes a strong acid from a concentrated one?
stem.et: Mis eristab tugevat hapet kangest happest?

label.en: Strength is how fully it dissociates; concentration is how much is dissolved
label.et: Tugevus näitab, kui täielikult hape dissotsieerub; kangus näitab, kui palju seda on lahustunud

label.en: They are two names for the same property
label.et: Need on sama omaduse kaks nime

label.en: A strong acid always has a pH below 0
label.et: Tugeva happe pH on alati alla 0

label.en: Strength measures how many pH units below 7 the solution sits
label.et: Tugevus mõõdab, mitu pH-ühikut allpool 7 lahus asub
